state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: daily meal allowance an intern on a client-site day in Paris
state.step_intent: Find the daily meal allowance that applies to: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today?

passages.source: HB-22 §2 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Exception for client-site days in London or Paris | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-02-01
passages.text: For client-site days in London or Paris, the daily meal allowance is 78 EUR per day instead of the standard amount. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-39 §3 | Travel policy: meals — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-20
passages.text: For a day with an approved client dinner, 37 EUR per day is added to the standard daily meal allowance. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-20 §3 | Travel policy: meals — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-02-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-39
passages.text: For a day with an approved client dinner, 37 EUR per day was added to the standard daily meal allowance. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.source: HB-30 §4 | Policy FAQ — Current daily meal allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard daily meal allowance? A: 42 EUR per day, as set in HB-39 §2 (effective 2026-04-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-22.

passages.source: HB-20 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-02-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-39
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel was 46 EUR per day. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.
